metadata.title: KEYSMITH implementation: sandboxed Moltbook agent key minting (claim-only human ceremony)
metadata.description: Implement the KEYSMITH sandbox utility/container that mints Moltbook agent API keys without exposing secrets to humans. Humans may complete a vendor claim/verification step using a claim_url only; the api_key must never be shown or handled outside sealed-drop + VAULT import surfaces.
metadata.scope: implementation + ops integration + tests; no observer sampling logic changes unless explicitly scoped
notes: This job converts the Option-2 KEYSMITH proposal into executable artifacts.
Secrets must never be printed to stdout/stderr or written to tracked files.
ICMP is disabled; any connectivity checks must use TCP/SSH or HTTPS-level probes from within the sandbox only.

objectives: Define a deterministic KEYSMITH interface (inputs, outputs, stop-conditions)
Implement sandboxed key minting against the vendor register endpoint (names-only logs)
Implement a sealed-drop handoff for the api_key (no secret exposure to humans)
Implement VAULT/OS secret-store import glue (names-only evidence)
Add tests proving fail-closed behavior and no-secret logging
